metadata.description: Claude Code mods by Robert Iuoras: see where each turn's time goes, every file Claude changed, the links it never opened, and a safety net for commands you can't take back.

plugins.name: flight-recorder
plugins.description: A live flight recorder for each turn: see where Claude's time goes, tool by tool, as it happens.

plugins.name: paper-trail
plugins.description: A live pane of every file Claude changed this session, with lines added and removed.

plugins.name: safety-net
plugins.description: Blocks shell commands that wipe your disk or home folder, and asks you first before a hard reset, a force push to main or a dropped table.

plugins.name: citation-check
plugins.description: When an answer cites links, one line names the ones Claude never opened.
